figures.name: Puer
figures.imagery: A sword; a male figure with exaggerated testicles
figures.body_type: A compact and athletic frame, with quick gestures and a complexion easily flushed by exertion or weather. The jaw and brow tend to be pronounced, the hairline somewhat uneven, and the hands often bear the small marks of tools, instruments, or contact sport.
figures.character_type: One who acts first and reflects afterward: competitive, blunt of speech, loyal in bursts, and restlessly curious. Such a person resists being managed and tends to find composure only after motion or contest has spent the initial charge.
figures.commentary: Puer names the martial impulse that arrives ahead of reflection. The classical authors place the figure under Mars and Aries: outer fire, inner air, with the intellect overrunning its own consequences. Three lines stand active while water rests, so the figure carries heat and edge without the tempering grace of feeling. Its image is not the lover but the engineer of pressure—force in search of a channel. Where the medieval tradition described the young soldier or the duelist, the contemporary practitioner should attend to vectors: who initiates, who escalates, and where the first blow lands. Puer favors questions that turn on decisive intervention and disfavors those that require patience, secrecy, or careful diplomacy.
figures.divinatory_meaning: Swift motion, the opening of a contest, surgical intervention, mechanical repair, or any matter in which force applied early shapes the field.
figures.tagline: Heat at the threshold—courage, hurry, and a blade that wants a sheath
favorable_for: Decisions that cannot wait for consensus
Opening or sustaining a legal defense
Breaking an impasse that decisive action can shift
unfavorable_for: Anonymous leaks or testimony without clear attribution
Diplomacy that requires many slow passes
figures.elemental_synthesis: Three active lines—fire, air, and earth—press outward while water lies passive, producing visible heat and articulation set against a dry emotional register. Inner air fans the outer fire, so that thought and speech accelerate action faster than feeling can refine it.
traditional_imagery: Sword or blade in classical geomantic glyphs
Youthful masculine signifier in historical figure tables
Mars and Aries paired in Renaissance correspondence wheels
interpretation: Read Puer as kinetic honesty: the chart is naming a place where the querent will not wait for consensus. In consultation, identify the cost of an impulsive message, an abrupt resignation, or a public statement that cannot be retracted.
Because water sleeps in this figure, empathy tends to arrive late. Where the matter calls for harmony, pair Puer with softer witnesses such as Albus or Populus before extending any promise of accord.
In questions of health and surgery, Puer can affirm a cut or a decisive treatment. In matters of love it marks pursuit and argument more often than steady union.

in_houses.1: Querent shows martial bearing: restless vitality, blunt carriage, ready to act.
in_houses.2: Cash and goods move fast; sharp spending, haggling, or dispute over the querent's purse.
in_houses.3: Siblings or neighbors carry heat; letters and local news may escalate quickly.
in_houses.4: The home stirs; repairs, boundary quarrels, or restless motion under one roof.
in_houses.5: Pleasure and risk run hot; bold wager, festivity, or pursuit of delight without patience.
in_houses.6: Labor intensifies; acute symptoms or friction with servants and hired help.
in_houses.7: The other party meets as rival or spark; contracts need firm, explicit terms.
in_houses.8: Death or surgical crisis may demand decisive action; another's purse contested under pressure.
in_houses.9: Long travel or higher study pressed forward; doctrinal debate grows edged.
in_houses.10: Public role sharpened; advancement thrust into view, or open tension with authority.
in_houses.11: Friends rally as allies; hope pursued with little hedging.
in_houses.12: A hidden enemy stirs or surfaces; haste and anger expose what was concealed.

in_court_roles.RightWitness: Querent-side momentum already engaged; urgency shaped the question more than calm review.
in_court_roles.LeftWitness: Outer climate escalates toward contest; rivals, deadlines, or systems press for open struggle.
in_court_roles.Judge: Verdict by decisive thrust; resolution through force of act, often at cost to goodwill.
in_court_roles.Reconciler: Verdict lands hot on the querent; gain in the moment asks later repair or restraint.

modern_examples: Sending a forceful wide reply before the correspondence has been read with care
Committing to a tournament, trial shift, or sprint chiefly to prove capacity or pride
Choosing immediate surgery when watchful waiting remains a reasonable alternative

traditional_sources.author: Heinrich Cornelius Agrippa
traditional_sources.work: Three Books of Occult Philosophy
traditional_sources.section: Book II, Ch. 14 & 22
traditional_sources.note: Standardized the Kabbalistic and Hermetic names for planetary spirits and intelligences.

figures.traditional_body_type: Historically associated with a compact, sturdy build, prominent musculature, and a ruddy or flushed complexion. Classical texts often note distinct or uneven facial features and a lack of dense facial hair.
figures.traditional_character_type: Traditionally described as impulsive, energetic, and prone to acting before thinking. Classical interpretations highlight a hot-tempered, youthful nature that lacks tact or foresight but possesses undeniable courage.

figures.name: Amissio
figures.other_names: Grasping externally, outer wealth, something escaped or lost
figures.imagery: A bag held mouth downward, letting the contents fall out
figures.body_type: A solid neck and a jaw that is either square or softly rounded, with a voice that carries. The shoulders are broader than the hips, and the hands handle weight with practiced ease.
figures.character_type: Warm, candid, and given to attachment that runs deeper than pride will easily admit. Such a person dislikes being overlooked and oscillates between open generosity and blunt requests.
figures.commentary: Amissio pictures the purse inverted: a Venusian appetite meeting an earth that cannot keep every coin. Fire and water flare without a steady mediating air, and earth at the rim lies passive, so what is gained slips because the vessel itself is open. The figure speaks not only of poverty but of release—what leaves makes room.
figures.divinatory_meaning: Outflow, ransom, donation, separation, depreciation, the shedding of debt, or the loss of track of an asset.
figures.tagline: What leaves makes room—open purse, shifting worth
favorable_for: Giving, donating, or downsizing by choice
Closing a bond that clings past its truth
Medical withdrawal or habit change under skilled care
Clearing stock, clutter, or backlog honestly
unfavorable_for: Keeping secrets that require a sealed vault
Locking into a long lease without exit
Compensation or perks that delay an honest exit
figures.elemental_synthesis: Fire and water are both active while air and earth lie passive: appetite and feeling move, but neither mediation nor structure follows. Value slips between the fingers because no airy contract and no earthen vault close the circuit.
traditional_imagery: Bag or purse inverted, mouth downward
Coins spilling in woodcut and emblem traditions
Venus and Taurus mapped on elemental correspondence wheels
interpretation: Read Amissio as value in motion toward the exit. The first question is whether what leaves is being poured out by intention or drained by neglect.
In matters of relationship the figure can bless a needed catharsis; in matters of finance it warns of thin margins unless Acquisitio answers it elsewhere in the chart.
Held with care, the figure teaches that some losses purchase freedom. The practitioner should verify, however, that the querent is not mistaking waste for sacrifice.

in_houses.1: Vitality thins; the querent's bearing loosens, as if an old habit or mask is falling away.
in_houses.2: Money flows out of the querent's hands; pay cut, levy, fees, or generous spend drains substance.
in_houses.3: Messages scatter reputation locally; a confidence escapes among kin or neighbors.
in_houses.4: Land or household stake passes away; sale, heirloom leaving, or duty that empties the dwelling.
in_houses.5: Pleasure thins; recreation deferred, a wager loses, or creative output set aside.
in_houses.6: Sickness or daily labor drains reserves; a pet changes hands; service hours shrink.
in_houses.7: Partner or adversary divides share; paths separate, or clientele drifts elsewhere.
in_houses.8: Inheritance scatters; insurer pays out; another's support thins or a loan is not returned.
in_houses.9: Far travel or university costs tuition; a gatekeeper declines admission or credential.
in_houses.10: Office or pay slips; public honor traded for private relief.
in_houses.11: Collective funding falls short; friendship strains after money changed hands.
in_houses.12: Hidden cost surfaces; confinement bill, leaked secret, or quiet bleed from neglected pact.

in_court_roles.RightWitness: Querent-side release already underway; asset, attachment, or expectation leaving by degrees.
in_court_roles.LeftWitness: Outer field draws value outward; partners, markets, or conditions pull substance away.
in_court_roles.Judge: Verdict is parting; something tangible exits the querent's grasp, chosen or not.
in_court_roles.Reconciler: Verdict leaves the querent leaner; fewer illusions, clearer sense of what sustains.

modern_examples: Liquidating a brokerage account to fund relocation abroad
Removing a dating profile after an honest conversation about limits
Selling tools and inventory after a deliberate change of vocation

traditional_sources.author: Christopher Cattan
traditional_sources.work: The Geomancie of Maister Christopher Cattan
traditional_sources.section: The descriptions and significations of the figures

figures.traditional_body_type: Classical sources describe a robust, large-boned frame of average height, often featuring a broad neck, rounded facial structure, and thick, abundant hair. A visible scar or mark is sometimes noted.
figures.traditional_character_type: Historically viewed as emotionally reactive and forthright. Older texts suggest a character driven by immediate attachments and a strong, sometimes inflexible, sense of personal honor, occasionally lacking strict honesty.

figures.name: Albus
figures.body_type: An upper torso held with quiet lift, breathing that remains steady under stress, and a preference for layered clothing. The fingers rest lightly at the keys or stain with ink.
figures.character_type: One who speaks little but precisely, keeps notebooks, and avoids crowds while building a small network with deliberation.
figures.commentary: Albus is the bright cup raised without spill: Mercury in Gemini, outer air over inner water, an intellect that mirrors a quiet depth. While the Renaissance standard (Agrippa) assigns this firmly to Mercury and Gemini, older Arabic traditions flowing through Gerard of Cremona sometimes lean toward Lunar or Cancerian rulership due to the 'white', reflective, and peaceful nature of the figure. In practice, Albus marks clarity won by stepping sideways from the fight.
figures.divinatory_meaning: Peaceful progress, study, paperwork that clears, the truce, the diagnosis that finally clarifies, and the gentle rain that follows drought.
favorable_for: Drafting briefs, policies, or testimony with care
Seeking a measured second clinical opinion
Careful review of records or policy with integrity as the aim
Letters of apology or clarification that hold proportion
unfavorable_for: Hostile acquisition or seizure by pressure
High-stakes deception or bluff as strategy
figures.elemental_synthesis: A single active water line within airy outer and inner shells: feeling and intuition move while fire and earth keep watch. Thought circulates after the manner of Mercury and Gemini, but embodiment and aggression remain temperate.
traditional_imagery: White cup standing upright without spill
Mercury's caduceus echoed in later emblem decks
Embassy-of-peace motifs in Cattan-era figure charts
interpretation: Albus rewards the querent who will document, breathe, and verify. The figure is a vote for procedure over charisma.
Because only water is active, momentum is subtle: progress here shows itself as errors caught early rather than as visible fireworks.
Where the chart contains adverse martial figures, Albus suggests cooling protocols—formal mediation, deliberate pause, or the careful edit of a trusted mentor.

in_houses.1: The querent favors restraint; bearing reads thoughtful, cool, and unhurried.
in_houses.2: Accounts steadied; modest surplus from disciplined cuts and honest reckoning of goods.
in_houses.3: Near kin cool into truce; siblings verify facts before feud or rumor spreads.
in_houses.4: Dwelling becomes sanctuary; measured repair, elder planning, or calm closure of a matter.
in_houses.5: Pleasure proceeds modestly; craft deepens; children or festivity handled with discretion.
in_houses.6: Healing follows regimen; calm pet; workplace rules applied with humane judgment.
in_houses.7: Mediator at the contract table; agreements read line by line before signing.
in_houses.8: Legacy or dowry settled without theater; inheritance paperwork clears; fear allayed by reason.
in_houses.9: Long journey papers advance; university outline wins measured approval; dream read with sobriety.
in_houses.10: Authority keeps temper; mentor shields junior from rumor; mother or boss shows sound judgment.
in_houses.11: Trusted ally offers counsel; hope stays modest and workable among friends.
in_houses.12: Dreams yield sober insight; hidden worry eases when stimulation and enmity leave the bedside.

in_court_roles.RightWitness: Querent-side origin is reflective; study and preparation in quiet rather than outward strike.
in_court_roles.LeftWitness: Outer milieu bends cooperative; mediators, documents, or goodwill incline toward querent.
in_court_roles.Judge: Verdict rests on clarity; document, ruling, or honest speech closes without theater.
in_court_roles.Reconciler: Verdict sits calmly on the querent; settlement endures because it was reasoned.

modern_examples: Assembling clear records before a regulatory or compliance interview
Deferring public reply until counsel or close friends have steadied the pulse
Resuming a household budget after honest avoidance has run its course

traditional_sources.author: Christopher Cattan

traditional_sources.section: The descriptions and significations of the figures

figures.traditional_body_type: Traditionally depicted with a broader upper body narrowing at the waist, a prominent head, and rounded features. Historical texts often attribute a neat or distinguished appearance to this figure.
figures.traditional_character_type: Classically interpreted as gentle, peaceable, and somewhat reserved. Older sources describe a kind-hearted individual who values quiet companionship but may struggle with financial prudence.

figures.name: Populus
figures.body_type: A torso that holds tension at the diaphragm and a gait that subtly synchronizes with whoever walks alongside.
figures.character_type: One who mirrors the company present and whose moods are easily caught by others.
figures.colors: Sea green or dark russet brown
figures.commentary: Populus is the throng: every line passive, water doubled within and without. The Moon's sign of Cancer underscores collective memory, tide, and the kitchen in which everyone speaks at once. Elementally, nothing initiates; inertia itself becomes stability.
figures.divinatory_meaning: The assembly, the audience, the poll, the household vote, the public mood, or any outcome decided by collective sentiment rather than by a single hand.
figures.tagline: Many voices, one tide—motion borrowed from the whole
favorable_for: Measured comparison of options across a sample
Peer support structured by mutual aid
Negotiation carried by union or collective voice
unfavorable_for: Solo venture without ally or crew
Disclosure without corroborating witness or record
Long concealment of invention or strategy alone
figures.elemental_synthesis: All four lines lie passive, so no element leads. The doubling of water at inner and outer registers suggests that emotional and somatic fields hold the field while fire, air, and earth remain latent. Change enters only when another figure energizes the row.
traditional_imagery: Crowd or multitude in classical glyphs
Double path in Renaissance geomantic keys
Moon and Cancer paired on elemental wheels
interpretation: Populus invites the question of whose tide the querent is swimming in. In the absence of a strong Judge elsewhere in the chart, drift should be expected.

In contemporary readings the figure points to the distributed actor: the circulating story, the household or team's ongoing exchange, the collective response. Agency is dispersed, and a single villain is rarely the answer.
When paired with Rubeus or Puer the crowd grows volatile; when paired with Albus or Fortuna Major it tends toward the benevolent.

in_houses.1: The querent reflects the crowd; bearing shaped by company, role, or public expectation.
in_houses.2: Income arrives in fragments; gratuities, piecework, or many small streams fill the querent's purse.
in_houses.3: Neighborhood rumor sets what counts as fact; local consensus steers messages and kin talk.
in_houses.4: Kinship table or shared dwelling decides by collective vote; tenants under one roof.
in_houses.5: Pleasure shaped by audience; festivity, play, or children seen through the group's eyes.
in_houses.6: Many bodies share one rhythm; clinic queue, shift roster, or open service hall.
in_houses.7: Marriage or firm bond lived before witnesses; jury or peer panel weighs the agreement.
in_houses.8: Obligation from the other party shared; dowry pool, legacy split, or support promised by the Seventh's person.
in_houses.9: Cohort of pilgrims or scholars; long travel in company; fellowship on the road.
in_houses.10: Institution's middle ranks convene; advancement follows the collective nod of office.
in_houses.11: Patrons and correspondents carry hope through fellowship; the withheld question may still be read.
in_houses.12: Hidden pressure without a single face; ward, exile, or diffuse enmity working unseen.

in_court_roles.RightWitness: Querent-side origin is collective; family, crew, or audience shaped the question from the first.
in_court_roles.LeftWitness: Outer motion is crowd-driven; quorum, rumor, or fellowship bends the path.
in_court_roles.Judge: Verdict belongs to the assembly; what the wider body settles stands.
in_court_roles.Reconciler: Verdict ripples through the querent's network; standing and memory outlive the moment.

modern_examples: A community-funded campaign exceeding its goal after trusted advocates widen the circle
Neighbors weighing whether a new shop may open—sentiment, not one officer, decides tone
A distributed team settling policy by asynchronous ballot across time zones

traditional_sources.author: Christopher Cattan
traditional_sources.work: The Geomancie of Maister Christopher Cattan
traditional_sources.section: The descriptions and significations of the figures

figures.traditional_body_type: Historical descriptions point to a taller, somewhat slender physique with narrower hips and elongated facial features. Classical texts frequently mention distinct marks or slight asymmetries in appearance.
figures.traditional_character_type: Traditionally characterized by a highly receptive and impressionable nature, easily swayed by the crowd. Older interpretations note a strong emotional current and a restless desire for travel or movement.

figures.name: Fortuna Major
figures.other_names: Inward fortune, protection going in, greater omen, inside or hidden help
figures.imagery: A valley through which a river flows
figures.body_type: Open, deep chest-breathing and warm, steady hands. The posture often shows a small compensation—one leg carried slightly differently from the other.
figures.character_type: Generous, quietly proud, and reliable in the keeping of promises. Such a person spends to lift others, dislikes pettiness, and bears responsibility without making a display of it.
figures.commentary: Fortuna Major is the sheltered valley that gathers water: Sun in Leo, yet the outer fire rests while inner earth and the active water and earth lines shape the terrain. The help arriving for the querent comes from foundations, elders, savings, or an institution with room enough to absorb shock.
figures.divinatory_meaning: Substantial fortune obtained through persistence, the inheritance of one's own past effort, institutional backing, or an integrity recognized late.
figures.tagline: Deep fortune, sheltered gain, earned stature
figures.elemental_synthesis: Fire and air lie passive while water and earth move: heat and debate quiet themselves as moisture and ground cooperate, after the manner of agriculture in a sheltered valley. Inner earth anchors the outer fire of the solar sign, so that the pride of Leo expresses itself as stewardship rather than display.
interpretation: Read this figure as the compounding interest of virtue: small, correct choices accumulate until the world begins to notice.
Paired with Tristitia, expect a long grind before the win; paired with Laetitia, the joy arrives after the foundations have settled.
When the figure occupies a court position—particularly Judge or Reconciler—it suggests an effect on legacy that reaches well beyond the immediate question.

in_houses.1: Confidence rooted in formation; the body restores itself when pace is allowed.
in_houses.2: Substance deepens through property, pension, or patient accumulation of goods.
in_houses.3: Circle of mentors; filings and local papers that shelter the querent near home.
in_houses.4: Ancestral holding; tended hearth; land and father line carry continuity.
in_houses.5: Children flourish under steadiness; patronage of arts, festivity, or honest speculation.
in_houses.6: Chronic ailment finds firmer footing; livelihood anchored by durable service contract.
in_houses.7: Partnership between peers; covenant weighted toward the long horizon.
in_houses.8: Another's support fulfills promise; inheritance or dowry gains sober, lasting value.
in_houses.9: Endowment or structured study abroad; pilgrimage or scholarship blessed with form.
in_houses.10: Standing earned by reliability; honor consonant with demonstrated tenure in office.
in_houses.11: Patrons commit substance, not applause alone; hope backed by real favor.
in_houses.12: Enforced quiet that still favors the querent; hidden protection, or large beast kept safely at distance.

in_court_roles.RightWitness: Querent-side origin is genuine standing; skill, reputation, or resources accumulated over time.
in_court_roles.LeftWitness: Outer conditions favor the querent; visibility, allies, and timing tend toward openness.
in_court_roles.Judge: Verdict affirms clearly; matter settles with querent's authority intact.
in_court_roles.Reconciler: Verdict compounds wisely on the querent; success leaves reserves for what follows.

modern_examples: Accepting a modest title at a durable institution when the wider economy contracts
Investing in seismic retrofit before the shock that would have tested the structure
A trust released when stated milestones, not appetite alone, have been met

traditional_sources.section: The descriptions and significations of the figures

figures.traditional_body_type: Classically associated with a well-proportioned upper body but occasionally uneven or asymmetrical lower limbs. Historical sources often note a radiant, rounded face with prominent, expressive eyes.
figures.traditional_character_type: Historically described as possessing a natural dignity, inherent fairness, and a generous spirit. Older texts highlight an ambitious but honorable nature that enjoys the comforts of wealth.

figures.name: Conjunctio
figures.body_type: A lithe waist and expressive hands that punctuate speech, with a digestion sensitive to stress.
figures.character_type: One who joins points quickly, takes pleasure in introductions, and is willing to entertain flexibility of means when better information becomes available.
figures.colors: Purple or pale gray, sometimes black speckled with blue
figures.commentary: Conjunctio is the crossroads at which streams meet: Mercury in Virgo, inner air over outer earth, with air and water carrying the motion. The contemporary practitioner may translate that intuition into the language of supply chains, networks, and the introductions that re-route a vocation. The figure is, by nature, morally mixed.
figures.divinatory_meaning: Networks, mediation, logistics, reconciliations of accounts, the recovery of items through a chain of acquaintances, and conversations that bring previously separate parties into agreement.
favorable_for: Hiring or placement through trusted networks
figures.elemental_synthesis: Active air and water braid through passive fire and earth: information and feeling circulate while ignition and ground wait their turn. The inner air steers the outer earth, so that analysis sorts the soil before any planting begins.
interpretation: Read Conjunctio in the manner of a graph: the nodes themselves matter less than the edges between them, and the practical question is who in the network will actually answer when called.
Recovery questions—lost belongings, missing records—often resolve under this figure, because strangers and second-hand acquaintances supply the linking clues.
If the Judge is harsh but Conjunctio sits on the ruler of the relevant house, a translator or intermediary may yet open the case.

in_houses.1: Querent sits at a hub; introductions and referrals define bearing and first approach.
in_houses.2: Income from split payments or several coordinated streams; goods exchanged by arrangement.
in_houses.3: Dense messages and short hops; kin or neighbors broker useful ties locally.
in_houses.4: Shared dwelling or divided title; hospitality linking households and land.
in_houses.5: Collaborative making; pleasure or artistry sustained through careful coordination.
in_houses.6: Shift swaps and handoffs; several hands on one regimen of care or service.
in_houses.7: Agent, co-counsel, or matchmaker at the heart of the contract or partnership.
in_houses.8: Debt restructured; another's funds released through escrow, timed conditions, or legacy split.
in_houses.9: Travel companionship; teacher or publisher opens the next gate on a long road.
in_houses.10: Overlapping duties; mentor sponsors access to authority and public office.
in_houses.11: Collective allocation; mutual aid depending on many small links among friends.
in_houses.12: Secret channels still connect; confidential lines, hidden go-between, or unnamed ally.

in_court_roles.RightWitness: Querent-side origin is recent convergence; contact, dispatch, or timely overlap shaped the question.
in_court_roles.LeftWitness: Outside keeps joining threads; introductions, agreements, or parallels recur.
in_court_roles.Judge: Verdict is union; resolution through alliance, contract, or merger that holds form.
in_court_roles.Reconciler: Verdict binds the querent into a tie; relationship or system outlasts the first transaction.

modern_examples: A measured introduction that secures the interview without exaggeration
A parcel traced through a neighbor's witness, yielding the decisive clue
A small facilitated group where the obstructing detail finally surfaces

traditional_sources.author: Christopher Cattan
traditional_sources.work: The Geomancie of Maister Christopher Cattan
traditional_sources.section: The descriptions and significations of the figures

figures.traditional_body_type: Traditionally depicted as having a delicate, slender, and attractive build. Classical descriptions often emphasize fine facial features, an elegant nose, and an overall nimble appearance.
figures.traditional_character_type: Classically viewed as highly communicative, sharp-witted, and socially adept. Historical interpretations often warn of a tendency to prioritize cleverness and networking over strict ethical boundaries.

figures.name: Puella
figures.imagery: A mirror; a female figure with exaggerated breasts
figures.body_type: A gracefully curved lumbar line, a long neck, and a voice naturally tuned to harmony. The lower back tends to register imbalance before the mind acknowledges it.
figures.character_type: One who seeks equilibrium and possesses a sharp aesthetic judgment. Such a person tends to avoid open conflict until cornered.
figures.commentary: Puella stands in counterpoise to Puer: Venus in Libra, outer air over inner water. The mirror in the figure's image hints at reciprocity—beauty understood as negotiation. Like Albus, older lineages stemming from Islamic sources sometimes assign Puella entirely differently (often linking her with Venus in Taurus instead of Libra), but the Agrippan model firmly places her here. The figure is favorable but inclined to fickleness.
figures.divinatory_meaning: Courtship, the care of surfaces, diplomacy, the fair division of goods, regimens of grooming, the elegance of a settlement.
favorable_for: Visual direction for a lasting work
Consultation on beauty, balance, or presentation
unfavorable_for: Long austerity demanding blunt endurance alone
figures.elemental_synthesis: Fire, water, and earth all act while air alone is passive: heat, feeling, and matter co-produce, while the cool intellectual distance thins. The scales of Libra here tip by mood more than by memorandum.
interpretation: Puella invites the practitioner to ask what is being polished for presentation, and what beneath the polish will hold once the audience departs.
The figure is excellent where art direction or attentive bearing changes outcomes; it grows risky where ethics require a blunt refusal.
Paired with Amissio, beauty exacts a cost; paired with Acquisitio, charm attracts the patron willing to underwrite it.

in_houses.1: Querent refines bearing; gracious presence advances the request before the court.
in_houses.2: Spending shaped by taste; craft income supplements the querent's purse; budget tuned to beauty.
in_houses.3: Diplomatic sibling or neighbor; local face of affairs carefully composed.
in_houses.4: Home arranged with care; deliberate cultivation of domestic harmony and land's appearance.
in_houses.5: Festivity or courtship begins; collaborative design; pleasure arranged with tact.
in_houses.6: Restorative regimen; nursing touched by comfort; equilibrium in daily service.
in_houses.7: Partnership planning or mediation; opposing party yields civility at the contract table.
in_houses.8: Graceful settlement of inheritance or dowry; another's support arranged with cosmetic fairness.
in_houses.9: Fellowship abroad in arts or letters; long journey for study or faith pursued with grace.
in_houses.10: Public name refreshed; deliberate renewal of reputation and office-bearing.
in_houses.11: Friends drawn by shared taste; support won through coherent, agreeable presentation.
in_houses.12: Hidden fondness or secret ally works softly; verify that charm is not masking a concealed enemy.

in_court_roles.RightWitness: Querent-side appeal shaped reception; tact, grace, or comeliness entered before the court.
in_court_roles.LeftWitness: Outer climate favors courtesy; mediators and pleasant conditions soften resistance.
in_court_roles.Judge: Verdict through harmony; agreement, beautification, or agreeable settlement.
in_court_roles.Reconciler: Verdict sits gently on the querent; relief through grace, yet verify substance beneath charm.

modern_examples: Choosing lodging whose order signals the hosts' genuine care
An acquaintance eloquent in conversation yet tentative when duty calls
A refreshed public face that draws notice while the substance of the work stays familiar

traditional_sources.author: Christopher Cattan
traditional_sources.work: The Geomancie of Maister Christopher Cattan
traditional_sources.section: The descriptions and significations of the figures

figures.traditional_body_type: Historical texts describe a highly symmetrical, graceful, and aesthetically pleasing form. Classical features include large eyes, a clear complexion, and a melodious voice.
figures.traditional_character_type: Traditionally characterized by an intense desire for harmony and a strong aversion to conflict. Older sources paint a portrait of a romantic, artistic soul who may sometimes appear fickle or easily distracted.

figures.name: Rubeus
figures.body_type: Skin that flushes readily, eyelids that hood under strong feeling, and a voice that drops in register when emotion rises.
figures.character_type: One who gives intimacy entirely or not at all, with a guarded streak of jealousy and an instinct to set the room in motion.
figures.colors: Red, flecked or streaked with brown
figures.commentary: Rubeus is the cup overturned: Mars in Scorpio, outer water over inner air. Passion that finds no upward outlet runs downward, and the medieval authors warned that this figure is good in evil things and evil in good ones. The practitioner must not moralize too quickly: at times Rubeus names a necessary surgery, a long-postponed honesty, or the investigation that will inevitably scorch its sources.
figures.divinatory_meaning: Intensity that strips the surface from a matter—the encounter that cannot remain decorous, the purge, the investigation, the long-postponed reckoning.
figures.tagline: Cup overturned, heat beneath the surface
unfavorable_for: Fundraising or offering before a scrutinizing public
Structured silent retreat governed by vows
figures.elemental_synthesis: Only air is active above passive fire, water, and earth: breath and story do all the steering while fuel, feeling, and ground stay inert—a pressure vessel that holds until something gives it vent.
traditional_imagery: Malefic joy in classical house lore
interpretation: The querent who draws Rubeus should never be shamed for it. The proper question is where the heat must be honored, and how it can be honored without scorching the people who depend on the querent.
Paired with Cauda Draconis, endings tend to be uncontrolled; paired with Caput Draconis, the same intensity becomes the engine of a deliberate rebirth.
When Rubeus occupies the first house, the figure asks the querent for honesty about motive—truthfully, and without flinching.

in_houses.1: Querent draws heat and desire; bearing magnetizes conflict; public mask may slip.
in_houses.2: Impulsive spending from the querent's purse; wager, indulgence, or costly emotional release.
in_houses.3: Private letter risks exposure; sibling quarrel turns sharp; rumor among neighbors.
in_houses.4: Something buried in home or patrimony surfaces; father line or land holds a secret.
in_houses.5: Intense festivity or reckless pleasure; creative work that does not flinch; risky wager.
in_houses.6: Illness needing blunt honesty; servant or employee conditions cannot be ignored.
in_houses.7: Obsessive tie with the other party; partnership diligence uncovers what was concealed.
in_houses.8: Contested inheritance or dowry; death's neighbor felt; another's purse bound under pressure.
in_houses.9: Hard doctrine or foreign study pursued to the root; dream or vision read without sentiment.
in_houses.10: Reputational crisis; misconduct exposed in office or before authority.
in_houses.11: Friendships tangled with appetite; alliances formed below the public surface.
in_houses.12: Old habit reasserts; hidden enemy or malicious craft feared; private dread long unnamed.

in_court_roles.RightWitness: Querent-side origin carries compromise; mixed motives, suppressed resentment, or impairment clouds the question.
in_court_roles.LeftWitness: Outer field intoxicates; temptation, scandal, or heated conditions distort judgment.
in_court_roles.Judge: Verdict compromised; answer true yet stained, or good ends pursued by harsh means.
in_court_roles.Reconciler: Verdict burns on the querent; relief mixed with shame, appetite, or needed cleanup.

modern_examples: A careful public account of a troubled workplace, accurate yet far-reaching
A lapse under strain answered by renewed, accountable commitment to healing
A vulnerability disclosed that forces an unavoidable ethical reckoning

traditional_sources.author: Heinrich Cornelius Agrippa
traditional_sources.work: Three Books of Occult Philosophy
traditional_sources.section: Book II, Ch. 14 (Zodiacal Angels - Corrected Barbiel)

figures.traditional_body_type: Classically associated with a rugged, powerfully built physique. Historical descriptions frequently mention a flushed or ruddy complexion prone to blemishes, alongside unruly hair and a deep voice.
figures.traditional_character_type: Historically viewed as possessing a volatile, intense, and heavily passionate temperament. Older texts often warn of an inclination toward excess, fierce temperaments, and indulging in life's harsher extremes.

figures.name: Acquisitio
figures.other_names: Grasping internally, inner wealth, something gained or picked up
figures.imagery: A bag held mouth upward, as though to take something in
figures.body_type: Broad hips and strong thighs, with a stride that covers ground efficiently. The hands accept what is offered without ceremony.
figures.character_type: An optimistic dealmaker who tends to believe that growth resolves most difficulties. Such a person speaks plainly, teaches what they know without pretense, and parts with their materials freely.
figures.commentary: Acquisitio lifts the purse: Jupiter in Sagittarius, inner air over outer fire. The medieval authors paired the figure with prudence, since appetite must still sort the genuine from the false. The practitioner tracks the figure's enlargement in land held, lore gathered, health regained, and patronage reckoned plainly.
figures.divinatory_meaning: Increase obtained from a recognizable source—a raise, a grant, an inheritance, the upward motion of an investment, the news of a child, the growth of an audience, the late harvest.
figures.tagline: Receiving vessel, widening fortune, prudent appetite
favorable_for: Purchase of arable land or workshop
figures.elemental_synthesis: Air and earth are active while fire and water remain passive: ideas and material cooperate, while passion and deep feeling stay tempered—a Sagittarian arrow set to the bow but not yet released.
interpretation: The first practitioner question concerns what will be done with the surplus. Without Tristitia somewhere in the chart, Acquisitio can deliver weight as readily as wealth.

Read in modern terms, the figure speaks of increase that admits an honest tally—steady yield from entrusted work, a circle of clients or hearers whose trust holds, inventories that swell—and the practitioner should look elsewhere in the chart for any sign of attrition.
Paired with Carcer, the gain locks into structure; paired with Via, the gain accumulates while the querent is in motion.

in_houses.1: Standing rises; confidence rooted in credential, training, or recognized bearing.
in_houses.2: Salary increase, dividend, or measured appreciation of the querent's held goods.
in_houses.3: Publisher or committee accepts; kin or neighbor furnishes trustworthy introduction.
in_houses.4: More ample dwelling or grounds; credible news of inheritance or family transfer of land.
in_houses.5: Word of a child; artistic prize; modest fortune through pleasure or patronage.
in_houses.6: Improved regimen or benefits; strength returning under disciplined care of servants.
in_houses.7: Partner or ally brings opportunity; joint venture equity or favorable compact.
in_houses.8: Beneficial movement in another's substance; insurer's payout, dowry, or patron capital.
in_houses.9: Long travel or study abroad permitted; advance for teaching; pilgrimage opens.
in_houses.10: Promotion, public honor, or invitation to board or governance.
in_houses.11: Benefactors multiply; collective appeal exceeds its mark; mentor widens introductions.
in_houses.12: Quiet benefaction from a hidden hand; favorable settlement whose source stays partly concealed.

in_court_roles.RightWitness: Querent-side upward momentum; means gathered and ready before the court speaks.
in_court_roles.LeftWitness: Outer waters run toward gain; opportunity, patronage, or favorable tide approaches.
in_court_roles.Judge: Verdict favors gain; matter concludes with increase of money, rank, or substance.
in_court_roles.Reconciler: Verdict enlarges the querent's field; acquisition reshapes later obligation.

modern_examples: Compensation arriving when a large obligation comes due, easing the ledger without spectacle
A modest readership or clientele at last crossing the threshold of sustainability
Welcoming an animal into the household who proves comforter and quiet guardian alike

traditional_sources.section: The descriptions and significations of the figures

figures.traditional_body_type: Traditionally described as having a solidly packed, stocky build with a broad, expansive chest. Classical sources often note shorter limbs and a generally dense, forceful physical presence.
figures.traditional_character_type: Classically interpreted as robustly enthusiastic with an immense appetite for life. Historical texts emphasize a strong, unwavering commitment to fairness and justice, coupled with an expansive, confident personality.

figures.name: Carcer
figures.body_type: Pronounced knees, careful steps, and a tension that gathers in the jaw. Such a person tends toward sturdy footwear, organizes receipts with method, and visibly stiffens when the conversation turns to budgets or commitments.
figures.character_type: Frugal, stubborn, and loyal to whatever protocol they have accepted. The fear of disorder runs deeper than the fear of boredom.
figures.commentary: Carcer is the lock and the ledger: Saturn in Capricorn, with earth doubled at the inner and outer registers. Energy meets matter without mediating elements, and work narrows to a single tunnel. The contemporary practitioner is left to ask whether the walls in question are protecting or suffocating—a contract, a savings instrument, a vow, a procedural hold.
figures.divinatory_meaning: Delay, the held deposit, the quarantine, the binding agreement, the fortified store, the long-term reserve, the institutional clock, the legal hold.
figures.elemental_synthesis: Fire and earth move while air and water lie still: heat and matter meet without breath or moisture to soften the encounter—the logic of a vault and the logic of a kiln stand together in one figure.
interpretation: Carcer paired with Fortuna Major can name a promotion delayed but ultimately certain; paired with Via, the impulse to break out contests with habit.
The practitioner should determine whether the lock under examination is external—a policy or contract—or internal, in the form of shame or reluctance the querent has not yet named.
In matters of finance, the figure often points to the trap of locked liquidity: capital exists, but a binding rule prevents its use.

in_houses.1: Self narrows under duty; composure kept through visible restraint of body and bearing.
in_houses.2: Liquidity gated by term or covenant; thrift enforced by bond and schedule on goods.
in_houses.3: Silence bound by agreement; distance from siblings or near kindred.
in_houses.4: Lien on domicile or land; elder care that fixes residence; end of matter delayed by form.
in_houses.5: Creative constriction; fertility governed by rule; pleasure postponed by vow or protocol.
in_houses.6: Service enclosure; chronic condition managed by regimen rather than cure.
in_houses.7: Prenuptial bond; non-compete; marriage sustained more by obligation than warmth.
in_houses.8: Trust with maturity date; systematic reduction of debt owed by another; legacy held in escrow.
in_houses.9: Higher study deferred by bureaucracy; visa or credential held in suspension.
in_houses.10: Hierarchy and clearance define motion; promotion paced by institutional clock.
in_houses.11: Collective rule freezes tiers; patron benefits locked by statute.
in_houses.12: Involuntary hold; imprisonment, hospital ward, or seclusion imposed for safety or remedy.

in_court_roles.RightWitness: Querent-side constraint already binding; question asked from inside contract, office, or habit.
in_court_roles.LeftWitness: Outer climate tightens; rules, gatekeepers, or limits narrow permitted motion.
in_court_roles.Judge: Verdict is closure or hold; matter fixed, secured, or shut away.
in_court_roles.Reconciler: Verdict walls the querent in; boundary set here endures; inner life must fit the structure.

modern_examples: A mandated review interval before publication or release may proceed
Choosing humbler quarters so that debt retires on an honest schedule
Licenses withheld in shame burdening the household more than truthful disclosure eventually would

traditional_sources.section: The descriptions and significations of the figures

figures.traditional_body_type: Historical descriptions point to a rigid, wiry frame characterized by visible physical tension, particularly in the shoulders and jaw. Classical texts note a tendency to cast the eyes downward.
figures.traditional_character_type: Traditionally viewed as highly conservative, cautious, and deeply inflexible. Older sources describe a character overly concerned with security, prone to hoarding resources, and resistant to change.

figures.name: Tristitia
figures.other_names: Crosswise, diminished, accursed, head down, fallen tower, cross
figures.imagery: A pit, a stake driven downward
figures.body_type: Heavy, well-set ankles and a preference for grounded footwear, with a deliberate, settling walk. Such a person is drawn to weighted objects.
figures.character_type: Dry of wit, loyal once trust has been earned through long acquaintance, and inclined to think in systems. There is a strain of realism that can edge into the depressive register.
figures.commentary: Tristitia drives the stake: Saturn in Aquarius, outer air over inner earth, with only earth active beneath three passive lines. The medieval authors named the figure sorrow, yet also recognized in it the foundation upon which towers may eventually stand if patience is allowed to do its work. Aquarius lifts the paradox into view: networks that freeze progress until the specifications improve.
figures.divinatory_meaning: A spell of low mood, a slide in valuation, the rumor of contraction, the work of digging, the long research, the funeral, the sober commitment.
figures.tagline: Weight downward, root deeper, truth slower
figures.elemental_synthesis: Earth alone acts beneath passive fire, air, and water: everything in the figure compresses toward soil. The Aquarian sky-ideas must wait until the ground itself confirms them.
interpretation: Where Tristitia and Laetitia stand together in the court positions, the practitioner may read the cyclical exhaustion and elation of a long undertaking, in which periods of weight alternate with periods of relief.
The proper question is what the matter requires the querent to bury in order to grow—seeds, infrastructure, or grief that has waited too long to be acknowledged.
In matters of justice, the figure points to slow proceedings, but to evidence that accumulates steadily in the querent's favor over time.

in_houses.1: Heaviness in bearing; doubt beneath outward competence of body and spirit.
in_houses.2: Reduced income; austerity; household economy narrowed to essentials.
in_houses.3: Dispiriting tidings; minor hurt or hindrance on a short journey or letter.
in_houses.4: Foundation or cellar wants repair; ancestral sorrow surfaces in the dwelling; end weighs heavy.
in_houses.5: Risk to conception; creative inhibition; pleasure withheld or soured.
in_houses.6: Chronic diagnosis; labor that earns little gratitude from servants.
in_houses.7: Partner withdrawn; lawsuit or negotiation draining by inches.
in_houses.8: Collector's pressure on inheritance; tax upon dowry or another's obligation.
in_houses.9: Scholarly rejection; long journey or visa refused; faith tested without lift.
in_houses.10: Whisper of demotion; advancement blocked by invisible ceiling in office.
in_houses.11: Hope postponed; fatigue in fellowship or common cause.
in_houses.12: Sorrow in confinement; secret burden bending the inner life; hidden enemy felt but unnamed.

in_court_roles.RightWitness: Querent-side grief or fatigue antedates the question; weight carried into the court.
in_court_roles.LeftWitness: Outer climate grinds; delay, scarcity, or institutional coolness wears the matter thin.
in_court_roles.Judge: Verdict is heavy; resolution slow and beneath hope's measure, yet true.
in_court_roles.Reconciler: Verdict saddens the querent personally; pain here schools gravity they will wield later.

modern_examples: Public contraction announced the day a long-prepared work finally appears
Years of records sifted to substantiate a claim that justice cannot hurry
Counsel modest and nearby accepted—and found, against expectation, sufficient

traditional_sources.author: Christopher Cattan
traditional_sources.work: The Geomancie of Maister Christopher Cattan
traditional_sources.section: The descriptions and significations of the figures

figures.traditional_body_type: Classically depicted with a heavy, settling, or slightly stooped posture. Historical texts often describe a drawn, serious countenance and a complexion lacking vibrant color.
figures.traditional_character_type: Historically characterized by profound seriousness, a penchant for solitude, and a lingering melancholy. Older interpretations note an immense capacity for sustained, solitary labor but a tendency to hold long grudges.

figures.name: Laetitia
figures.other_names: Bearded, laughing, singing, high tower, head lifted, candelabrum, high mountain
figures.body_type: A buoyant step and well-formed feet, a laugh that involves the whole torso, and hair worn somewhat freely. Such a person tends to go barefoot at home.
figures.character_type: Possessed of an innocent enthusiasm and a capacity for genuine awe. The temperament is given to the gambler's optimism and the swift forgiveness.
figures.commentary: Laetitia lifts the head: Jupiter in Pisces, inner fire over outer water, with fire alone active while its siblings rest—a torch raised against fog. The medieval joy figures warned that elevation invites visibility: the tower attracts the lightning. The practitioner therefore balances elation with discretion.
figures.divinatory_meaning: Promotion, public success, the spiritual lift, the rallying of sentiment, the news of a child, the season of celebration.
figures.tagline: Tower lights, uplifted spirit, bright hazard
favorable_for: Popular lecture or broad explanatory piece
unfavorable_for: Unadvertised dissent or quiet resistance alone
figures.elemental_synthesis: Only fire acts within a Piscean shell of water: enthusiasm pierces the fog while air and earth remain latent—a lifted balloon awaiting the ballast that another figure must supply.
interpretation: Laetitia welcomes the public stage. The practitioner should determine whether the querent is in fact ready for the scrutiny that arrives with the applause.
Paired with Tristitia, the elation is followed by a corresponding contraction; paired with Fortuna Minor, the rise is rapid and the descent more rapid still.
In matters of health, the figure prompts attention to sustainability. A debt of sleep or rest is often concealed behind the glow.

in_houses.1: Querent visibly lifts; renewed color, bearing, or reputation abroad.
in_houses.2: Windfall bonus; equity rises on credible report of the querent's goods.
in_houses.3: Correspondence finds wide reception; sibling or peer earns local distinction.
in_houses.4: Festivity at home; favorable estimate of land; good news toward the matter's end.
in_houses.5: Joy of conception; exhibition or concert; pleasure crowned with notice.
in_houses.6: Word of remission; new pet under the roof; servants cheer the regimen.
in_houses.7: Betrothal celebrated; partnership praised in the circle that matters.
in_houses.8: Beneficial inheritance movement; dowry or legacy concluded with relief.
in_houses.9: Admission to chosen study; pilgrimage or devotional journey secured.
in_houses.10: Chief officer applauded; nomination or laurel in the trade.
in_houses.11: Patronage succeeds among friends; fellowship tastes hope again.
in_houses.12: Relief inside constraint; hidden benefactor or softened imprisonment; large beast prospers in quiet.

in_court_roles.RightWitness: Querent-side spirits lifted; recent grace, healing, or influx entered with the question.
in_court_roles.LeftWitness: Outer field runs buoyant; festivity, blessing, or favorable tide moves toward querent.
in_court_roles.Judge: Verdict is joyous; matter resolves in relief, success, or liberty withheld too long.
in_court_roles.Reconciler: Verdict lifts the querent durably; new height becomes customary ground.

modern_examples: A successful première that lays bare how slight the footing beneath applause proves to be
Truth hoarded for years spoken aloud, welcomed, then paid for in weariness
Unexpected gain whose announcement draws strangers and distant kin to the threshold

traditional_sources.author: Christopher Cattan
traditional_sources.work: The Geomancie of Maister Christopher Cattan
traditional_sources.section: The descriptions and significations of the figures

figures.traditional_body_type: Traditionally described as tall and broadly built, featuring large hands, feet, and facial proportions. Classical sources often paint a picture of a somewhat uncoordinated but imposing physique.
figures.traditional_character_type: Classically viewed as fundamentally good-natured, joyful, and deeply sincere. Historical texts often point to a profound, almost naive innocence and a strong inclination toward spiritual or religious devotion.

figures.name: Cauda Draconis
figures.other_names: Outer threshold, threshold going out, lower boundary, stepping outside
figures.imagery: A doorway with footprints leading away from it
figures.body_type: A left arm that bears the marks of a long history, a posture that subtly turns away from a crowded room, and shoulders held a little unevenly.
figures.character_type: A generosity that runs to depletion, an instinct to give until little remains and then to withdraw, and a guarded skepticism toward what may be received in return.
figures.colors: Green, white, dark crimson, or pale tawny brown
figures.commentary: Cauda Draconis marks the threshold of the southern lunar node. While strictly lacking Planetary Intelligences or Spirits in the Agrippan model (hence 'None'), later Hermetic and Arabic practitioners often assigned Cauda the malefic properties of Saturn or Mars. The motion is not cruelty; it is completion with teeth. The figure releases what it carries, after the manner of a stage discarded once its work is done.
figures.divinatory_meaning: Closure, the residual risk that gathers at an exit, the formal end of a binding tie, graduation, the deliberate winding-down of an organization or regimen, resignation from work that has worn the querent down.
figures.tagline: Closure at the threshold; what exits carries consequence.
favorable_for: Formally ending what honesty no longer sustains
Closing a lease or tenancy with clear papers
Closing a long public role or practice by deliberate design
Stepping away from restrictive alliances or dogmas
unfavorable_for: Renewing vows or bonds meant to endure
Extending provisional locks or freezes indefinitely
Preserving tenure or standing when integrity asks release
figures.elemental_synthesis: Three active lines press above a passive earth: heat, idea, and tear all move outward without soil to receive them—the figure releases what it carries, after the manner of a stage discarded once its work is done.
interpretation: Read with Caput Draconis, the figure tells a complete lifecycle question: the head proposes, and the tail disposes.
In matters of finance, the figure marks write-offs, refunded transactions, and the long aftermath of an investment that did not hold.
In matters of the spirit, the figure points to the initiation that requires the querent to leave an old name at the door before crossing.

in_houses.1: Established bearing laid down; former role or name honorably retired from the helm.
in_houses.2: Formal discharge of debt; losses booked from the querent's accounts without denial.
in_houses.3: Correspondence or kin ties shortened by deliberate, humane closure.
in_houses.4: Household clearing; elders downsizing or leaving family land; matter moves toward its end.
in_houses.5: Creative arc concludes; grief after loss of work or pregnancy accepted.
in_houses.6: Resignation from ill-suited service; course of care reaches natural end.
in_houses.7: Partnership dissolution settled; steady patrons quietly drift away.
in_houses.8: Will executed; debt forgiven or estate closed; death's business concluded.
in_houses.9: Credential completed; lawful expiry of visa or study permission.
in_houses.10: Leadership handed off; public standing pivots from old narrative.
in_houses.11: Hope consciously relinquished; circle of allies thoughtfully narrowed.
in_houses.12: Discharge after confinement; hidden truth surfaces, then the chapter seals.

in_court_roles.RightWitness: Querent-side origin is conclusion; exit, severance, or closing chapter brought the question.
in_court_roles.LeftWitness: Outer field narrows; openings shutter, allies withdraw, ending favored over extension.
in_court_roles.Judge: Verdict is termination; resolution by release; clinging turns closure into loss.
in_court_roles.Reconciler: Verdict clears space for the querent; honest ground remains after the threshold.

modern_examples: Closing a long-held public affiliation once its climate has turned decisively hostile
A last scheduled shift before a workplace is folded into a successor organization
The final meeting of sustained counsel, when the work is honored and laid to rest

traditional_sources.author: Christopher Cattan
traditional_sources.work: The Geomancie of Maister Christopher Cattan
traditional_sources.section: The descriptions and significations of the figures

figures.traditional_body_type: Historical texts frequently describe a form bearing the visible marks of hardship or age. Classical descriptions point to a worn appearance, perhaps featuring old scars, thinning hair, or a rugged asymmetry.
figures.traditional_character_type: Traditionally associated with a tendency toward dissolution and sudden severances. Older sources warn of a bitter or untrustworthy streak when cornered, alongside a fatalistic acceptance of loss.

figures.name: Caput Draconis
figures.other_names: Inner threshold, threshold coming in, upper boundary, high tree, upright staff, stepping inside
figures.imagery: A doorway with footprints leading toward it
figures.body_type: A right arm conditioned to carry whatever new responsibility has been accepted—the working tool, the bag of provisions, the child.
figures.character_type: An earnest improver, given to method and to small acts of considered kindness. There is a recognizable anxiety before a major beginning.
figures.commentary: Caput Draconis greets the threshold of the northern lunar node: earth doubled within and without, while air and water move and fire keeps watch—a fertile furrow. Like the Cauda, the Caput lacks formal Agrippan Intelligences, but Arabic and later occult traditions commonly assign it the benefic, expanding properties of Jupiter or Venus. Virgo refines appetite into craft. The practitioner should ask what seed is actually being planted.
figures.divinatory_meaning: The new offer of work, the news of a child, the formal invitation, the first stage of a project, the arrival of a mentor.
figures.tagline: A fertile threshold; beginnings ask disciplined tending.
favorable_for: Taking up sworn or rotated service that may summon at uneven hours
Call confirming adoption or guardianship placement
Commencement of scholarship or funded study
Immigration milestone such as biometrics or interview
Structuring a sabbatical or renewal leave with intent
unfavorable_for: Final severance or terminal payout scenes
Shuttering an institution meant to endure
figures.elemental_synthesis: Air, water, and earth all act while fire waits in passivity: craft, care, and soil cooperate while the raw ignition holds in reserve—the seedling held in greenhouse conditions until the season permits its planting outdoors.
interpretation: Caput Draconis tends to favor the paperwork that unlocks. The practitioner should verify deadlines carefully, so that the door is not closed by a lapse the querent could have prevented.
Where Cauda Draconis appears in other houses of the same chart, the larger story is one of migration—an outbreath in one quarter, an inbreath in another.
In matters of resource, the grant or award most often arrives accompanied by conditions, and those conditions deserve the same attention as the gift itself.

in_houses.1: Renewed bearing; first intake of regimen or intentional habit at the helm.
in_houses.2: Initial wages from new employment; grant funds deposited to querent's purse.
in_houses.3: Admission letter or credential advance; kin or peer opens vocational door locally.
in_houses.4: Keys to new dwelling; room prepared for arrival, elder, or growth on the land.
in_houses.5: Confirmed conception or creative acceptance; festivity of beginning.
in_houses.6: Structured onboarding; partnership with clinician or coach for upkeep of health.
in_houses.7: First sincere union or compact among founders signed at the contract table.
in_houses.8: Investment executed; corrective surgery booked; another's support pledged clearly.
in_houses.9: Travel permission stamped; study begins under mapped syllabus; faith renewed.
in_houses.10: Elevation of office; outward narrative drafted with care before authority.
in_houses.11: Trusted ally elevated in community; initiative dear to hope gains sanction.
in_houses.12: Dream redirects toward admitted care; sanctioned beginning after hidden trial.

in_court_roles.RightWitness: Querent-side fresh ground; recent arrival of home, role, or binding pledge.
in_court_roles.LeftWitness: Outer field presents thresholds; invitations, openings, or roads not yet walked.
in_court_roles.Judge: Verdict is inception; resolution favors beginning; chapter opened shapes what follows.
in_court_roles.Reconciler: Verdict roots into the querent; commitment taken becomes vocation, bond, or craft.

modern_examples: Badge or credential admitting entry on the first day of service
Residency status affirmed and the slow lattice of lawful paperwork commenced
Word that a child will join the household, met with proportionate preparation

traditional_sources.author: Pseudo-Agrippa
traditional_sources.work: Fourth Book of Occult Philosophy: Of Geomancy
traditional_sources.section: Of the Significations of the Figures

traditional_sources.author: Christopher Cattan
traditional_sources.work: The Geomancie of Maister Christopher Cattan
traditional_sources.section: The descriptions and significations of the figures

figures.traditional_body_type: Classically depicted as well-proportioned, slender, and generally pleasing to the eye. Historical descriptions often highlight abundant hair and distinct, clear facial features.
figures.traditional_character_type: Historically characterized by an innate, steady kindness and a calm demeanor. Older texts emphasize a highly reliable, trustworthy nature that naturally seeks to nurture and build.

figures.name: Fortuna Minor
figures.other_names: Outward fortune, protection going out, lesser omen, outside or apparent help
figures.imagery: A mountain with a staff atop it
figures.body_type: A straight spine and a quick pivot at the hip, with eyes that habitually read the horizon. The handshake is firm, but the attention is rarely settled in the room for long.
figures.character_type: A proud helper, willing to shoulder the rescue when the moment calls for it. Such a person rises sharply on praise, accepts correction with humility after a misstep, and tends to share what they have generously.
figures.commentary: Fortuna Minor crowns the ridge: Sun in Leo, yet with outer air over inner fire. The classical contrast with the valley of Fortuna Major is exact: here, fortune rides on the wind. The gift comes from a referral, a sudden spotlight, a willing patron, or a moment of public attention. It is easily won and easily spent.
figures.divinatory_meaning: The brief win, the surge of attention, the borrowed ladder, the bonus that lands at the right moment, the moment of public favor.
figures.tagline: Swift favor from without; depth must be earned afterward.
favorable_for: Moments where a narrow tide of fortune decides the outcome
Emergency extraction or urgent rescue logistics
Expedited access granted by trusted gatekeepers
Brief contests judged on plain, published expectations
unfavorable_for: Instruments meant to mature across generations
figures.elemental_synthesis: Fire and air move while water and earth lie still: heat and wind cooperate, while moisture and soil wait their turn—a banner upon the battlements rather than a root within the slope.
interpretation: The first practitioner question is whose footing upholds this flash of fortune, since that measure foretells how long brightness can hold.
Where the Reconciler in the chart is unfavorable, the promotion conferred by this figure tends to feel hollow over time, and the practitioner does well to revisit the matter at a later date.
The instructive contrast is with Fortuna Major: the same solar sign, but very different depths of soil beneath the same crown.

in_houses.8: Patron bridges another's purse; finance arrives under pressure, not yet secure.

in_houses.11: Support rallies in a burst among friends; hope crests quickly.
in_houses.12: Anonymous gift or hidden transfer; verify before trusting concealed favor.

in_court_roles.LeftWitness: Outer help runs fast yet conditional; patronage timely but not guaranteed to hold.
in_court_roles.Judge: Verdict favors the near horizon; success rests on circumstance beyond full ownership.

An ensemble engaged after one recording traveled farther than years of local work
A prize captured in a narrow window few rivals had prepared to meet

figures.traditional_body_type: Traditionally described as possessing a solid, slightly heavy build of average height. Classical sources note a rounded face, prominent features, and thick, often unmanageable hair.
figures.traditional_character_type: Classically viewed as outwardly boastful and fiercely proud, yet harboring hidden insecurities. Historical interpretations highlight a fundamentally generous, honor-bound nature beneath a blustering exterior.

figures.name: Via
figures.body_type: A stomach sensitive to anticipation, a body practiced at handling motion, and the small habits of one who travels often.
figures.character_type: A nomadic heart and a temperament that moves with its own tides. Such a person is loyal but needs new horizons to remain whole, prepares carefully for the road, and writes most clearly when between one place and the next.
figures.commentary: Via opens every line: Moon in Cancer, water doubled inside and out, with all four elements active—a tidal highway. The medieval authors named the figure the road; today one may rightly add pilgrims' routes, post-roads, caravans, long migration, and the journey of identity. Nothing in this figure remains still; even sleep is the rhythm of cycles.
figures.divinatory_meaning: Relocation, change of lane, pivot, route, movement of households, goods, rumor, or kith—the long transition.
figures.tagline: Every line open; the stream keeps renewing its channel.
favorable_for: Relocation and immigration paced with orderly papers and kin
Moving household, hearth, or trade in deliberate stages with room to revise
Journey by road or water marked by chosen halts and watchful pacing
Long convalescence, pilgrimage, or apprenticeship unfolding in successive phases
Handwork or study refined through repeated trials rather than one sealed design
unfavorable_for: Reputation or office judged on unmoving tenure in one chair
Vows or covenants founded on unmoving fixity
Custody of children, wills, titles, or evidence requiring an unbroken lawful chain
figures.elemental_synthesis: All four lines act: fire, air, water, and earth cycle without rest. The figure presents the complete permutation, and the doubled water of Cancer asks intuition itself to do much of the steering as the way unfolds.
interpretation: Via answers the question of how rather than the question of where, and process tends to dominate outcome until the Judge of the chart freezes the frame.
Read with Carcer, the figure can describe a commute that has become a confinement; read with Populus, it describes the moment in which a great many people set out at once.
In matters of finance, the figure points more readily to cash flow than to savings: value moves through the querent's hands rather than accumulating within them.

in_houses.1: Bearing under revision; lawful change of name or outward presentation in progress.

in_houses.9: Education abroad; devotional miles accumulated; long journey as the answer itself.
in_houses.10: Profession lived from hall to hall; vocation staged by travel between offices.
in_houses.11: Shared transport toward shared aim; collective hope expressed as march among allies.
in_houses.12: Transfer between places of confinement; dream imagery dense with roads and gates.

in_court_roles.RightWitness: Querent-side passage; question asked mid-transition among homes, roles, or vows.
in_court_roles.LeftWitness: Outer field keeps reshaping; timelines and corridors refuse stasis.

in_court_roles.Reconciler: Verdict relocates the querent; new coordinate after miles is the durable lesson.

figures.traditional_body_type: Historical descriptions point to a body that carries weight lower down, often described as pear-shaped. Classical texts mention a tendency to perspire easily, a pale complexion, and softer, rounded features.
figures.traditional_character_type: Traditionally characterized as highly mutable, restless, and deeply sensitive to environmental changes. Older sources emphasize a constant need for movement and a strong aversion to being tied down.
